column1: # Arc blocks as the builder's encode_arc writes them (builder/src/arc_blocks.h): the grid exponent k,
# what the case covers, the vertices in e7 units (lat,lng;...), and the block as hex. The builder's
# tests encode each to the block and decode it back; the server's decode it to the vertices and its
# test encoder (arc_fixture.rs) must write the same block. Regenerate with geocoder/testdata/gen_arc_vectors.cpp.
